title: Create and set up your app - Play Console Help
key_points: You can create apps and set them up using Play Console after creating your Google Play developer account.
Open Play Console to create your app.
Select Home in the left navigation menu.
limitations: The information is specific to setting up an app on Google Play Console, which may not encompass all methods of app creation and setup.
asserts: After creating a Google Play developer account, you can create apps and set them up using the Play Console.
